name: Spotlight Search
description: Apple-inspired Spotlight search bar with fluid capsule-to-quad-button expansion, staggered harmonic spring physics, and real-time category filtering.
summary: An ultra-fluid macOS Spotlight search bar component engineered with harmonic spring physics and dynamic layout morphing. At rest, it presents an iconic 480px glass capsule search bar with pulsing caret and dark frosted aesthetics. Upon hover, keyboard focus, or text input, the search capsule smoothly compresses to 248px while seamlessly breaking into four 48px circular action buttons (Applications, Folders, Workspaces, and Documents) with staggered spring kinematics, zero cumulative layout shift (total width fixed at 480px), full keyboard navigation, active category filters, and an interactive search results tray.
highlights: Seamless layout morphing from a single unified 480px capsule into a search input and four satellite action buttons
Viscous SVG gooey liquid layer creating organic metaball neck stretching and detachment during expansion and fusion during collapse
Continuous absolute coordinate transforms ensuring zero flexbox layout reflows and zero cumulative layout shift
Deliberate friction-damped spring kinematics (stiffness: 170, damping: 24, mass: 1.0) for luxurious Apple liquid gliding
High-fidelity macOS icons: Apple 'A' Applications, system Folders, multi-tier Workspaces, and Folded Documents
Real-time category-based filtering with dynamic placeholder hints and active filter badge dismissals
Interactive results tray with keyboard arrow-key navigation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape)
Micro-tooled hover tooltips with scale-in micro springs and dark frosted glass backdrop styling
anatomy: <svg> (Scoped filter definition with feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 5.5 and high-contrast feColorMatrix alpha thresholding)
<div> (Gooey liquid backdrop layer with capsule and button blobs under the SVG goo filter)
<motion.div> (Morphing search capsule with dark frosted glass, white border highlights, and search icon)
<input> (Accessible text input with dynamic placeholder and keyboard navigation)
<motion.div> (Satellite filter button cluster with staggered spring transitions and custom SVG iconography)
<motion.div> (Expandable floating search results tray with item metadata and shortcut badges)

physics.engine: Friction-Damped Harmonic Oscillator & SVG Metaball Shader
physics.description: Slow, viscous spring physics governing capsule width compression and button translation, coupled with GPU-accelerated SVG gooey thresholding.

accessibility.aria: aria-label on search input and filter buttons, title tooltips, full keyboard navigation with Escape to clear, ArrowUp/ArrowDown to select, and Enter to submit.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Responsive spring animations respect reduced motion preferences with graceful CSS fallback transitions.

recommended: Top-level global search command bars in modern macOS or web applications
Interactive command palettes with categorical drill-downs
Desktop-inspired navigation interfaces requiring high visual polish
bestPractices: Keep total container width constrained to prevent surrounding layout shifts during hover expansion
Provide meaningful category filters corresponding to the application's core data models
Pair with keyboard shortcuts (e.g. ⌘K) to open or focus the search input
